entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: West to southwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Low. Changes: The chance of upgrade for this Watch has been decreased to Low.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers are expected to affect the road Saturday night and early Sunday morning. 1 to 2 cm of snow may accumulate above 800 metres, with lesser amounts down to 600 metres.
